tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background under the drifting glow.

tokens.name: surf
tokens.usage: Base of every glass fill: --panel is 58% of it, --raised 80%, --solid 92% mixed with --bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, icons and the bond lines of molecules. Text on --bg, --surf and every glass fill.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on --bg and glass: hints, eyebrows, mono labels, stat-pill labels. 12px and up; never the only copy of key information.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel borders, dashed list dividers, segmented-control outlines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interaction: selected tab pill, primary button, focus ring, links, the italic first letter of a title, nitrogen atoms. Addition reactions.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on --accent fills (selected tab, primary button). In dark variants it is the palette background.

tokens.name: redox
tokens.usage: Redox reactions; oxygen atoms; wrong answers (via --bad). Badge text, chip fills, flowchart arrows.

tokens.name: ligand
tokens.usage: Ligand exchange (inorganic) and substitution (organic) reactions.

tokens.name: acidbase
tokens.usage: Acid–base reactions; halogen atoms; right answers (via --good). Blue-teal in Rosé Pine.

tokens.name: amph
tokens.usage: Amphoteric (inorganic) and elimination (organic) reactions; Mg atoms; the synthesis-target accent.

tokens.name: cond
tokens.usage: Condensation / hydrolysis reactions: the seventh hue, taken from each palette (pink, cyan, frost, rose, aqua, orange).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Correct answer: pulse ring, tick and border colour.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Wrong answer: shake, strike-through and border colour.

tokens.name: b1
tokens.usage: First background glow blob (top-left, 55% strength). Decorative only.

tokens.name: b2
tokens.usage: Second background glow blob (right, 45%). Decorative only.

tokens.name: b3
tokens.usage: Third background glow blob (bottom, 40%). Decorative only.

tokens.name: hl
tokens.usage: The 1px inset top highlight on glass: box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 var(--hl).

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Soft drop shadow under glass, tinted with --ink in light variants.

tokens.name: sheen
tokens.usage: The 155° sheen gradient laid over glass fills.

tokens.name: tilebg
tokens.usage: The white tile behind test tubes and apparatus. Stays light in EVERY theme so chemical colours read true.

tokens.name: tilegrid
tokens.usage: 44px grid lines on the white tile.

tokens.name: tile-ink
tokens.usage: Glassware outlines and captions drawn on the white tile (all themes).

color.note: The default palette (Catppuccin). Five more palettes, each light and dark, use these exact token names: see Palettes and components/bundle.css.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title, clamp(30px, 3.8vw, 46px). First letter italic in --accent.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Result names, win banners, procedure titles (21–28px).

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Card titles: target compound, product card, section heads (19–22px).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drag a compound and a reagent into the circle.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Reflux keeps the aldehyde in the flask.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: Names on small cards and tiles.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above the title; panel headers use 12px at .1em.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase stat-pill labels, badges, chips, captions.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Tabular numbers in stat pills (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: equation
styles.usage: Equations and data; digits after symbols become <sub>, charges <sup>.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside the tab bar and segmented controls (3–4px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, stat pills and buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between small cards in a grid (7–8px).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in codex grids.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel header padding (12px 14px 6px); header row gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Inner horizontal padding of panels and stages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between bays; page side padding (max with the safe area).

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Top padding of the header.

tokens.name: r-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, flowcharts, the bottom sheet. 30px inside @supports (corner-shape: squircle).

tokens.name: r-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the reaction circle, tiles. 22px with squircles.

tokens.name: r-md
tokens.usage: Small cards, reagent cards, options, theme rows. 16px with squircles.

tokens.name: r-sm
tokens.usage: Equation boxes, chips, flowchart swatches. 12px with squircles.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Pills stay fully round: tabs, buttons, stat pills, badges, filter chips, the dock.

tokens.name: glass-shadow
tokens.usage: Glass panels and cards: inset top highlight plus a soft drop shadow.

tokens.name: primary-glow
tokens.usage: Primary button and the selected tab pill (the glow is --accent at 70%).

tokens.name: ctl
tokens.usage: Height shared by the theme pill and the tab bar (they must always match).

tokens.name: ctl-phone
tokens.usage: --ctl at 480px and below.

tokens.name: blur
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(175%) on glass (26–30px on the dock and sheet).

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of .wrap.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Above: title | theme pill | tabs on one row. At and below: title row, then 4-column tabs beside the theme pill.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Below: one column, dots-only theme button, transposed flowcharts, bottom drawer instead of side lists.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: At and below: button grids go to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-small
tokens.usage: At and below: short tab labels.

tokens.name: bp-tiny
tokens.usage: At and below: tab text 12px.
